rejected.title: Bootstrapped and Need AWS
rejected.reason: The post says a bootstrapped startup needs help to scale on AWS but cannot afford it; it specifies no concrete chore, inputs, or repeatable output. Inventing a cost audit, migration, or architecture task would exceed the evidence, so no experiment can be responsibly scored.

steps.message: Assessed the sole sealed discussion assignment. Its broad request for affordable AWS scaling help does not identify a concrete task to scope; excluded it without inventing duties. No post proposed.
